about_short_description.short_description: Productboard is a product management system that helps organizations get the right products to market faster.

product.name: Productboard
product.description: A cloud-based product management platform for collecting customer feedback, organizing feature ideas, prioritizing work, aligning product strategy, and creating shareable roadmaps.

product.name: Productboard Spark
product.description: An AI-assisted product management capability for synthesizing feedback, researching competitors, creating product briefs and PRDs, and connecting product decisions to evidence and strategy.

product.name: Productboard Portal
product.description: A customer-facing portal for sharing planned and released features, collecting feedback, validating ideas, and engaging customers throughout the product development process.

product.name: Productboard API
product.description: An API for connecting Productboard with external systems and automating the exchange of product, feedback, planning, and roadmap data.
